detail: Provider-mode creation accepts first_name, last_name, email and send_invitation_email. Both oneOf branches require only first_name and last_name and allow additional properties, so the documented staff request also matches self-signup and is rejected by oneOf.

The required expandable attendance collection is oneOf array<integer> and array<AttendanceRead>. An empty collection matches both, so the minimal generated event response is rejected. The node preserves unexpanded collections, as documented, and must not fabricate attendees.

The published OpenAPI 3.0.3 document uses type: ["integer"] for image IDs in OfferingTypeCategoryRead and RegistrationTimelineRead (among other schemas). Full generated EventRead includes these deferred objects and openapi_schema_validator raises TypeError: unhashable type: list. Minimal fallback then hits the overlapping attendance oneOf. Deferred fields are optional according to TeamUp docs; the node does not request them or inspect image IDs.
